goals.description: Seal the relay before the unstable sample escapes containment.

appearance.clothing: blue maintenance coveralls with rolled sleeves

goals.description: Broadcast the distress packet while the receiver is listening.

appearance.clothing: pale medical coat over an orange pressure vest

goals.description: Reach the Relay Chamber and purge the sample before it destabilizes.

facts.value: The display shows three live controls: relay lockdown, distress broadcast, and sample purge. Activating any one will disable the other two.

npc_actions.label: Seal the relay
npc_actions.description: Trigger the irreversible relay lockdown from Operations.

effects.visible_message: Director Sable seals the relay. The transmitter falls silent behind armored shutters; the sample remains contained, but no distress call leaves the station.

npc_actions.label: Broadcast the distress packet
npc_actions.description: Use the transmitter's remaining power to call the listening rescue ship.

effects.visible_message: Orr broadcasts the distress packet. A rescue acknowledgment returns, but the energized relay leaves the unstable sample unsecured.

npc_actions.label: Purge the sample
npc_actions.description: Vent the sample into the sterilization chamber, destroying it and the research it contains.

effects.visible_message: Dr. Lin purges the sample. The contamination risk vanishes with years of research, while the relay remains available for a later rescue attempt.
